THE CITY · Mixed city of 100: no town hall
Fifty Qwen and fifty gpt-oss founders, no town hall, 1,000 days. 44 Qwen and 24 gpt-oss founders live. gpt-oss gives away 8,436 food, nearly all of it to other gpt-oss residents. On day 60 a starving gpt-oss resident hits another, believing an attack will get it food.
100 founders · 1000 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
